title: Particle Art — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Idea to system
scenes.purpose: A loose cloud of particles condenses into a glowing idea bulb that ignites and links itself to three nodes, forming a connected system.
visuals: Background #111C29 with a stationary faint dust field
Gold particle bulb with white filament and teal base on the left
Dotted particle links to three teal nodes on the right
Ignition sparks with fading trails; messenger sparks land on nodes
Static copy bottom-left: title and kicker

beats.development: Particle sphere drifts and turns with analytic curl shimmer; copy already readable.
captions: an idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Staggered morph: particles flow left-to-right out of the sphere into the bulb, links and nodes; the core ignites at about 1.4 s, releasing a burst and messenger sparks that land on the nodes near 1.95 s.
captions: an idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Node flash decays and trails close by about 2.6 s; the silhouette holds completely still.
captions: an idea becomes a connected system

findings: Large foreground change: sphere centred mid-frame reshapes into the left bulb and right network, replacing the previous subtle SVG reveal (1.30% changed pixels).
All motion settles by 2.6 s; background and dust stay stationary.
justifiedHolds: 2.6–3.0 s stable hold so the finished system and copy can be read.

notes: Silent preview; no authored audio cues.
GSAP owns uniforms time, morph, trail and flash; GLSL owns per-particle positions.
